description: Public Mojang/Minecraft identity services for UUID and username lookup primarily at api.mojang.com; related session validation and skin/texture profile data are served from sessionserver.mojang.com, and newer account/services flows use api.minecraftservices.com.
resolution_notes: Auditor correct on description. Official/community docs (wiki.vg Mojang API) and live hosts separate concerns: username	o UUID at https://api.mojang.com/users/profiles/minecraft/<name>; session/profile (incl. textures) at https://sessionserver.mojang.com/session/minecraft/profile/<uuid>; Microsoft-era account APIs at https://api.minecraftservices.com. Original description implied a single api.mojang.com surface for profiles, textures, and session validation. Evidence: https://wiki.vg/Mojang_API and https://wiki.vg/Mojang_API#UUID_to_Profile_and_Skin.2FCape
